title: i need honest feedback on something i built
author: Outrageous-Ad-4819
selftext:
hey guys, i’m from argentina and i’ve been working on a project called botiquant. it’s completely free right now and i’m mainly looking for honest feedback from people who are into trading, algo trading or backtesting.  
basically, i wanted to build something that lets you create and test automated trading strategies without having to know how to code.  
the software doesn’t use ai to magically generate strategies or make trading decisions. everything runs in python using historical market data.  
you choose the asset, timeframe, indicators, entry/exit conditions and some other parameters, and botiquant searches through different combinations to find strategies that actually worked on the historical data.  
then you can analyze the results with metrics like profit, drawdown, win rate, number of trades, equity curve, etc. you can also separate in-sample and out-of-sample data to see how the strategy performs on data it wasn’t optimized on.  
once you find something interesting, you can export the strategy to metatrader 5 or tradingview without having to write the code yourself.  
the idea isn’t to sell “profitable bots” or claim that a backtest guarantees anything. it’s more like a research/backtesting tool that makes systematic trading more accessible.  
it’s free right now because i’m still improving it and i’d rather get real users testing it and telling me what sucks, what’s confusing, what features are missing, etc.  
i made a video showing the whole process here:  
[https://youtu.be/YUy3VjlpJ3Q](https://youtu.be/YUy3VjlpJ3Q)  
the video is in spanish because i’m argentinian, but you can turn on youtube subtitles to follow along. the platform itself can be used in english.  
i’d really appreciate honest feedback, even if it’s negative. especially from people who already build or backtest trading systems.
